caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical device, predominantly colored in various shades of brown, suggesting the natural texture and grain of wood. The main structure consists of two elongated, rounded handles on either side, parallel to each other, joined by crossbeams and held together by wooden pegs or bolts. Attached between the handles and centrally located is a large circular saw-like disk with serrated edges, also rendered in a wood texture. Inside the framework, a set of vertical wooden slats is visible, supported and intersected by diagonally braced timbers. Off to the right of the main object, there is an outline (uncolored and not shaded) of a separate tool that appears to be a handled crank or lever, also rendered in simple line work. The background is plain and light beige, and there is a signature in the lower left corner.
title: Grape Crusher
